en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a broad cobbled road lined with two‑ and three‑story masonry buildings. On the right is a prominent classical-style building with a balcony, identified as the post office, while further along the street is a war hospital. A tall telegraph/telephone pole with multiple crossarms stands in the center distance, and a horse-drawn wagon is visible on the street. Handwritten German text appears at the top, and small printed credits at the bottom left.
